title: Pune court awards death sentence to 65-year-old for rape and murder of 3-year-old child
description: A special POCSO court in Pune on June 29 sentenced a 65-year-old man named Bhimrao Prabhakar Kamble to death for the rape and murder of a three-year-old girl [State of Maharashtra v. Bhimrao Prabhakar Kamble].Judge SR Salunkhe passed the ruling, while observing that it was time for courts to enforce strict laws enacted by the legislature in letter and spirit.“The deterrence shall not remain on paper, it shall reflect from the field.
